correction: Replace March 2024 with March 2023 for the emergency crisis and takeover announcement. FINMA records the announcement on 19 March 2023 and legal completion on 12 June 2023.
effect: Corrects the chronology of an ancillary historical example. The leverage-risk argument remains.
limits: No conclusion about the sufficiency of the bill’s safeguards. This does not refute the claimed Archegos connection or imply intent; a clerical year slip is plausible. Collapse is treated as ordinary crisis shorthand, not a claim of formal bankruptcy.
materiality_explanation: Minor: the year does not change the existence of the example, its relationship to the earlier Archegos episode, or the policy mechanism under discussion.
direction_explanation: No demonstrated advantage to the author’s request from shifting this past event by one year; direction is null.

independent_ai.summary: Independently checked paragraph, request, exact bill, FINMA chronology, and potential 2024 corporate-integration alternative. Group acquisition June 2023 and bank merger May 2024 do not rescue March 2024.
